🌀 #WilmaPH / #Nokaen Update
Issued: Tuesday, December 2, 2025 
– 4:00 PM Philippine Time

TROPICAL disturbance #93W / #Invest93W in the West Pacific Ocean basin is currently moving northwest at 15 km/h, and is expected to begin a turn toward the southwest on Wednesday, December 3, 2025. As this turn begins, a TROPICAL DEPRESSION is likely to form within the next 24 hours as the system tracks toward the #EasternVisayas and the #Bicol region of #Mindanao, #Philippines.

All residents and friends in these regions should be closely monitoring this system, making immediate preparations, identifying safe shelter, and evacuating coastal areas as necessary. 93W is expected to strengthen into TROPICAL STORM #Wilma / #TropicalStormWilmaPH / #TropicalStormNokaen, bringing the following hazards:

Torrential TROPICAL rain squalls

Winds of 85–110 kph

Dangerous seas, surf, and coastal flooding

Life-threatening flash flooding across both inland & island communities

Serious infrastructure damage, including flooded homes (potentially up to rooftops) and washed-out roads

Please continue to monitor official PAGASA updates and follow the Hurricane/Typhoon/Cyclone Updates & Information page for 24/7 coverage.

Respectfully,

Roshin

data.raw_text:
The Philippines is the virtual assistant capital of the world. If an American wants a virtual assistant today, the Philippines is where they look first.

You know what that means?

As a Nigerian, there’s a massive opportunity for you to get into that market.

Americans are paying $10-25/hour for Filipino VAs doing basic admin work. 

That’s ₦15,000 - ₦35,000 per hour at today’s rate. In a month, you’re pulling ₦1-4 million monthly working from your house in Abeokuta.

Meanwhile, a Nigerian graduate is fighting for less per month for office jobs.

The math isn’t mathing for staying local.

These Filipinos didn’t dominate this space by accident. They built a reputation, systems, and trust over 15+ years, but that advantage is going away.

Why?

Because American companies are diversifying, they’re tired of putting all their eggs in one basket. When COVID hit, and the Philippines went into hard lockdown, businesses scrambled. They learned their lesson: never rely on a single country for your entire remote workforce.

Right now, they’re actively looking for alternatives. Kenya. South Africa. And yes, Nigeria.

The window is open, but it won’t stay open forever.

As a Nigerian, you have English proficiency. You have hustle. You have the timezone advantage (you can cover both US morning and evening shifts). 
Filipinos have to work midnight in their time to match the American morning time zone.

So why are you not tapping into this?

Because what you’re missing is the skills, positioning and access.

These skills are not coding, and they're non-technical. As long as you can read, write and communicate properly, you can do this.

The companies hiring VAs aren’t posting on Nigerian job boards. They’re on Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, and niche VA platforms. 

They’re paying in dollars, and they don’t care about your degree, your skin colour or accent. They only care about the tools you can use and the results they can get.

This isn’t some “get rich quick” thing. 

It’s arbitrage. 

Pure economics.

They need affordable labour. You need hard currency. 

You do good work, they pay you well (by your standards), they save money (by their standards). 

Everyone wins.

But here’s the catch...

In 3-5 years, everyone will figure this out. The market will flood. Rates will compress. The advantage will disappear.

You’re either early or you’re late.

The Filipinos got in early. They built the infrastructure, the training systems, the reputation pipeline. Now they’re printing money.

You can either watch from the sidelines or get in immediately.

The opportunity is here. Right now. In 2025, going into 2026.

What are you waiting for?​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

I spent hours and weeks recording a course on everything I know about this. The tools and knowledge you need. The results you can get. Everything that takes you from not knowing anything about this to landing your first remote job and earning in dollars in the next 3-4 months.

The course won't be available for much longer at this price. 

Click here to get access to it now => https://t.co/l76JoqtyNQ 

P.S. I also uploaded a nice video for you there that explains everything in detail. Watch it immediately.

Again, the link is => https://t.co/rx8rLhQB7D
